deviations: Table 1 sociodemographics coded as: age (years, linear), female dummy, eduyrs (years; 11 missing -> N drops to 3008), income as factor with 'No answer' kept as a category, occupation as a factor (the data has a single item covering both main economic activity and employment status), citizenship dummy, household size (numeric), self-assessed social status (0-10, numeric), religion factor, state factor.
National battery = the 8 ref_* items (integrating, citizenship, reduce, moredone, cultgiveup, economy, crime, terror) entered linearly; local battery = the 8 ref_loc_* items entered linearly.
Additional controls = contact_ind, distance_ref (factor, incl. don't know), settle_ref (factor), afd_ind, afd (0-100 closeness), lrscale, muslim_ind.

SI Table C1: Excess Males trimmed at the 2.5th/97.5th percentiles of the municipality-level (2015 cross-section) distribution; controls = log population, log pop density, pop change 2011-15, log unemployment rate, male/female unemployment ratio, log refugee stock 2014, log refugee inflow 2014-15, % highly educated, % manufacturing, change in % manufacturing, AfD 2013 vote share, log violent crime per capita; state FE (plus year FE in the annual model); fixest::feglm logit, SEs clustered by county; complete cases.
notes: Independent blind reproduction from paper text and codebooks only; no author scripts or .tex outputs exist in the mount and none were read. Attempt-1 was exploratory (variable inspection, no RESULT lines). Attempt-2 crashed on a coefficient-name lookup (backticked name) before printing results; fixed without any specification change. Final run prints all 13 quantities; check_attempt reports none missing. Sum model: municipality coded 1 if Hate_all_muni summed over 2015-2017 > 0. Five states drop out of the logit samples entirely because of missing controls (complete-case), leaving 11 state FE.
